project.name: portfolio-v2
project.description: An Angular 19 portfolio website featuring CV/resume display, work experience timeline, and project showcase with technology filtering and PDF CV export.

nodes.name: ArchitectureOverlayComponent
nodes.summary: Angular component that renders an interactive architecture overlay panel, tracking page section visibility via IntersectionObserver and displaying contextual metadata, source code, and pipeline diagrams for each portfolio section.

nodes.name: ArchitectureOverlayComponent
nodes.summary: Listens to scroll events and IntersectionObserver to detect active page sections, driving the overlay panel's source-code view, highlight, and metadata display via ArchitectureOverlayService.

nodes.name: architecture-overlay.const.ts
nodes.summary: Contains all static AOEntry and AOEntryV2 configuration data for the architecture overlay, mapping each portfolio section to its description, technology stack, data sources, source code snippets, and pipeline steps.

nodes.name: ArchitectureOverlayService
nodes.summary: Angular injectable service managing the architecture overlay state — toggling visibility, tracking the active section, controlling source/pipeline views, and providing section metadata from AOEntries constants.

nodes.name: ArchitectureOverlayService
nodes.summary: Singleton service managing the architecture overlay's reactive state via BehaviorSubjects for active/inactive, active section, and source-view mode, with methods to get section metadata.

nodes.name: ProjectItemComponent
nodes.summary: Angular component rendering a single portfolio project card, checking the project URL liveness via fetch, generating avatar initials, and tracking project link clicks via analytics.

nodes.name: ProjectItemComponent
nodes.summary: Accepts a Project input, pings the project URL to check liveness, generates name initials for avatars, and opens external links with analytics tracking.

nodes.name: TimelineItemComponent
nodes.summary: Angular component rendering a timeline entry for work or education experiences, supporting collapsible responsibility lists with expand/collapse toggling.

nodes.name: TimelineItemComponent
nodes.summary: Accepts an array of Experience objects and provides expand/collapse toggling for responsibility lists with a configurable collapsed limit.

nodes.name: CvComponent spec
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the CvComponent, verifying the component creates successfully with its injected dependencies.

nodes.name: CvComponent
nodes.summary: Standalone Angular component for the CV page that renders the CV HTML from getCVTemplate, and downloads a pdfmake-generated PDF on demand with lazy-loaded pdfmake chunks.

nodes.name: CvComponent
nodes.summary: Reads CV data from localStorage, renders the HTML CV on init, and provides a download() method that lazily loads pdfmake and generates a PDF.

nodes.name: HomeComponent spec
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the HomeComponent, verifying the component creates successfully in a TestBed setup.

nodes.name: HomeComponent
nodes.summary: Primary Angular page component rendering the full portfolio — user bio, technology skills grouped by category, filtered work/education experience timelines, and project cards — with dark mode toggle, CV download, and scroll-driven section detection.

nodes.name: HomeComponent
nodes.summary: Main portfolio page that assembles user, project, experience, and technology data into a multi-section layout with dark mode toggle, tech filtering, CV download via PageService, and architecture overlay integration.

nodes.name: PagesRoutingModule
nodes.summary: Defines the routes for the pages feature module: '/home' maps to HomeComponent, '/' redirects to '/home', and '/cv' maps to CvComponent.

nodes.name: PagesModule
nodes.summary: Feature NgModule declaring all portfolio page components and shared UI components, providing core services, and importing PagesRoutingModule to register page routes.

nodes.name: work-type.enum.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WORK_TYPE enum classifying employment relationships (direct, outsourcing, intern, education, training) used across experience models and CV providers.

nodes.name: base.model.ts
nodes.summary: Base domain model extending TimeRange with an optional CV exclusion flag, serving as the common ancestor for Experience, ResponsibilityCategory, and WorkProject models.

nodes.name: BaseModel
nodes.summary: Abstract-like base class extending TimeRange with an optional exclude_in_cv flag to suppress entries from CV output.

nodes.name: experience.model.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Experience domain model representing a work, education, or training entry with position, responsibilities, categorized responsibilities, and nested projects.

nodes.name: Experience
nodes.summary: Core domain class for a professional experience entry, holding position metadata, flat and categorized responsibilities, nested projects, and WORK_TYPE classification.

nodes.name: range.model.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the TimeRange class with optional started_at and finished_at date strings, serving as the temporal foundation for all model classes.

nodes.name: TimeRange
nodes.summary: Simple value class holding optional start and end date strings, extended by BaseModel to provide temporal context across all domain models.

nodes.name: responsibility-category.model.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ResponsibilityCategory model grouping responsibilities under a named category title, used within Experience and WorkProject for structured CV rendering.

nodes.name: ResponsibilityCategory
nodes.summary: Groups a list of responsibilities under a titled category, supporting both standard and CV-specific bullet lists for flexible CV rendering.

nodes.name: work-projects.model.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WorkProject model representing a specific project within a work experience entry, including nested responsibility categories for detailed CV output.

nodes.name: WorkProject
nodes.summary: Represents a sub-project within an Experience, holding its name, flat responsibilities, CV responsibilities, and categorized responsibility breakdowns.

nodes.name: cv.provider.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the CV provider verifying HTML and PDF output of getCVTemplate and getCVPdfDefinition across categorized, flat-fallback, concise, and direct experience scenarios.

nodes.name: experience.provider.ts
nodes.summary: Static data provider exporting two Experience arrays — the full chronological work/education history and a separate training/certification list — consumed by CV and page services.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses spread operator to merge training_experiences into the main experiences array, keeping training data modular.

nodes.name: AppRoutingModule
nodes.summary: Defines the root Angular router configuration with lazy-loaded route to the pages module.

nodes.summary: Unit test for the root AppComponent, verifying the component creates successfully.

nodes.name: AppComponent
nodes.summary: Root Angular component serving as the application shell with router-outlet.

nodes.name: AppComponent
nodes.summary: Root application component that hosts the router outlet for page navigation.

nodes.name: AppModule

nodes.name: TimelineRangeComponent

nodes.summary: Defines the User data model class with personal contact and profile fields used throughout the CV generation pipeline.

nodes.name: User

nodes.summary: Angular injectable service providing file download utilities, including saving HTML content as a file and managing temporary blob URLs.

nodes.name: page.service.ts
nodes.summary: Angular injectable service that orchestrates CV generation and PDF export by combining user, experience, technology, and project data into a downloadable PDF via html2pdf.

nodes.name: PageService

nodes.name: saveCV

nodes.name: cv.provider.ts

nodes.name: getCVPdfDefinition

nodes.name: getCVTemplateV1

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Start at src/main.ts — the Angular bootstrap that loads AppModule and launches the app. Then look at app.module.ts to see the root module imports, and app-routing.module.ts for the lazy-loaded routing to the pages feature.

tour.title: Domain Data Models
tour.description: Explore the model layer in src/app/models/. The BaseModel extends TimeRange (started_at/finished_at), and Experience, Project, Technology, and User all inherit from it. These types flow through every layer of the app.

tour.title: Static Data Providers
tour.description: The src/app/providers/ directory is the content layer — all portfolio data is hardcoded here. technologies.provider.ts exports ~50 named Technology constants grouped into FRONTEND, BACKEND, DEVOPS, and more. projects.provider.ts builds the projects array from those technology references. experience.provider.ts stores the full work history.

tour.title: CV Generation Pipeline
tour.description: cv.provider.ts is the heaviest file at 925 lines. It exports three renderers: getCVTemplate() (modern ATS HTML), getCVPdfDefinition() (pdfmake document), and getCVTemplateV1() (legacy layout). cv-style.provider.ts holds the legacy embedded CSS. The pipeline culminates in PageService.saveCV() which converts the HTML to a PDF blob via html2pdf.

tour.title: Pages Feature Module
tour.description: PagesModule declares all page and shared UI components and provides the core services. PagesRoutingModule maps /home → HomeComponent and /cv → CvComponent. This is the feature boundary that Angular's lazy-loading targets from the root router.

tour.title: Home Page — Portfolio Hub
tour.description: home.component.ts is the main page, orchestrating everything: it imports data directly from all providers, filters experiences by WORK_TYPE, drives the technology category filter UI, and delegates CV download to PageService. Its template (home.component.html at 369 lines) renders the hero, skill grid, timelines, and project grid.

tour.title: Shared UI Components
tour.description: Three reusable components power the home page: ProjectItemComponent renders a single project card with live-status checking; TimelineItemComponent renders an experience entry with collapsible responsibilities; TimelineRangeComponent formats the date range label. Their SCSS files define the visual presentation.

tour.title: CV Page
tour.description: cv.component.ts reads CV data from localStorage (written by the home page's download flow), renders the HTML CV via getCVTemplate(), and provides a download button that lazily imports pdfmake at click time to generate a PDF with getCVPdfDefinition().

tour.title: Architecture Overlay Feature
tour.description: A unique feature of this portfolio: the architecture overlay panel. ArchitectureOverlayService manages visibility state via RxJS BehaviorSubjects. The component tracks scroll sections via IntersectionObserver, highlights the active section, and displays architecture metadata, source snippets, and pipeline diagrams from the const file.

tour.title: Global Styles & Theming
tour.description: styles.scss defines the global CSS custom properties for light/dark theming (--bg-color, --text-color, etc.) and imports Bootstrap overrides. The assets/scss/timeline.scss provides the vertical timeline layout used by TimelineItemComponent.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: The Dockerfile builds the app in Node and serves it via Nginx (nginx.conf handles SPA routing with a catch-all to index.html). Four GitHub Actions workflows cover: CI testing, GitHub Pages deploy, AWS S3/CloudFront deploy, and AWS ECS deploy.
